Issue Date: 2025-07-01 | Effective Date: 2025-08-01

Clause 1: Eligibility & Benefits
Eligibility and benefits for Emergency Distress Student Relief Grant (Hardship Relief Fund): Award benefit includes Up to Rs. 50,000 emergency relief. Minimum academic threshold: No CGPA bar (Family bereavement/crisis). Active backlogs disqualify candidate unless condoned.

Clause 2: Application Procedure
Application protocol: Online application through Student Portal before 30th September. Verification done by Scholarship Committee within 21 working days.
